text.p: - Worldaid 96, a combined conference and exhibition for worldwide humanitarian assistance, opened on Monday in Geneva, represented by 245 firms, 45 relief organisations and nine countries.
- Switzerland is expecting an above-average production of 1,158,000 tonnes of sugar beets to make 170,000 tons of sugar this season.
- Elektrowatt Group posted a massive profit decrease for the 1995/96 fiscal year based on high reserves in real estate.
- The Swiss government authorised a payment of 600 million Swiss francs to unemployment insurance because of the worsening employment situation.
- Some 600 jobs were cut in France due to the merger of pharmaceuticals Ciba and Sandoz into Novartis.
- The Publicitas Group's first six months profit, 26.3 million Swiss francs, stagnated compared to the same period in 1995.
- The French-speaking canton of Neuchatel voted in favour of a 9.945 million Swiss franc credit for costs at the Expo 2001. REUTER
